description: This file is a Java interface defining service methods for handling customer option sets in an e-commerce context. It declares methods for saving/updating customer option sets and retrieving them based on store, option, or option value.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetService
classes.description: Java interface for managing customer option sets, providing methods for save/update and retrieval based on different criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer option set or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer option sets associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByOption
methods.description: Retrieves customer option sets associated with a specific customer option and store.

methods.name: listByOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves customer option sets associated with a specific customer option value and store.
